fallos_mitigaciones: Update adapter's teacher-generated training data over-predicts unnecessary NONE (no-action) updates for previously retrieved memories instead of focusing on new extractions; mitigated by filtering training data to only process updates related to new extractions (§3.2, Data Preparation – Update Adapter).
cita: Bini et al. (2025). MemLoRA: Distilling Expert Adapters for On-Device Memory Systems.
notes: mem_tipos=SEMANTICA: Mem0-style extracted facts/preferences ('Mel loves movies', 'Mel is in the mood for romantic movies', Fig.1/§3.1 Knowledge Extraction) + MULTIMODAL: MemLoRA-V vision expert adapter + LoCoMo VQA augmentation (§3.3). representacion=VECTOR: memory store M retrieved via FindRelatedKnowledge(M,q) based on semantic similarity, inherited from Mem0 (§3.1). operaciones=WRITE;ACTUALIZACION: extraction expert Le writes facts, update expert Lu decides ADD/UPDATE/DELETE (§3.1-3.2). trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM: the (distilled) SLM adapter decides ADD/UPDATE/DELETE per exchange, not a fixed rule. retrieval=EMBEDDINGS: semantic-similarity lookup (§3.1). mide_lectura=SI: Table1 L/J scores measure memory-augmented generation quality (confirms F_screening RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO). alcance=SESION: LoCoMo '10 extended, multi-session dialogues' (§4.1). multiagente=NO, fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no staleness/verification mechanism beyond standard ADD/UPDATE/DELETE. evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (Table1 explicit ΔJbase vs base SLM without adapters: +25% to +90%) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Table1-2 vs Gemma2-27B/GPT-OSS-120B). F=RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;COSTO confirmed (matches F_screening): COSTO via the 10-60x smaller-model on-device efficiency framing (§1,§4.1); no explicit token/latency numbers were found within the read budget. handoff=CONTENIDO: extracted facts persist and are reused across LoCoMo's multi-session dialogues. Key numbers: MemLoRA+GPT-OSS-120B-teacher J=47.2 vs base Gemma2-2B J=24.9 (+90%, Table1); MemLoRA-V VQA 81.3 vs caption-based 23.7 accuracy (Abstract).

cita: Jiménez Gutiérrez et al. (2024). HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models.
notes: mem_tipos=SEMANTICA: static, corpus-wide 'artificial hippocampal index' built offline from a fixed passage corpus into an open KG of triples (§2.2 Offline Indexing) -- general factual/world knowledge, not per-session episodic user memory. representacion=GRAFO;VECTOR: schemaless KG of noun-phrase nodes/relation edges (§2.2) plus dense-encoder synonymy edges E' from Contriever/ColBERTv2 (§2.3, Table1 graph stats). operaciones=WRITE: one-shot offline OpenIE triple extraction per passage (§2.3); no update/forget/admission logic described. trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: indexing runs deterministically over every passage in P at ingestion time, no LLM-discretionary write/forget policy. retrieval=GRAFO;EMBEDDINGS: Personalized PageRank over the KG seeded by query nodes (§2.2-2.3) + dense-encoder cosine similarity linking query named entities to KG nodes. mide_lectura=SI: R@2/R@5/EM/F1 extensively measured (Tables2-4). alcance=NA: HippoRAG is a static single-corpus multi-hop QA/IR system with no dialogue-session/task/project/org boundary defined. multiagente=NO, fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no staleness/contradiction handling described. benchmarks/metricas: MuSiQue/2WikiMultiHopQA/HotpotQA (Table1), R@2/R@5/EM/F1 (EXITO) + '10-30 times cheaper and 6-13 times faster' online retrieval than IRCoT (Abstract, §4, Appendix G) for COSTO-TOKENS;LATENCIA. evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (Table5 'Dissecting HippoRAG': OpenIE alternatives, PPR alternatives, w/o node specificity, w/o synonymy edges) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Tables2-4) + MEDICION-COSTO (cost/speed multipliers). F=WRITE;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;COSTO confirmed unchanged vs F_screening. handoff=NO: no cross-session/agent content transfer defined (static corpus retrieval, not a conversational agent). RECONSIDERAR: general-purpose multi-hop RAG/IR method evaluated on static QA corpora, not clearly an LLM-agent long-term dialogue/task memory system as elsewhere in this corpus -- borderline membership, left to human reviewer.

fallos_mitigaciones: Redundant/outdated information accumulating in long-term memory degrades retrieval efficiency and can cause LLM decision errors from stale/inaccurate info; mitigated by an Ebbinghaus-forgetting-curve-based memory update strategy (exponential decay R(t)=R0*e^(-t/λ), §III.D) that forgets rarely-recalled segments while reinforcing frequently-retrieved ones (review effect). Also explicit categorization/handling of conflicting historical knowledge entries about the same fact (§III.B).
cita: Li, Jing & Jing (2024). Vector Storage Based Long-term Memory Research on LLM.
notes: mem_tipos=EPISODICA (dialog memory: query/response pairs per round, §III.B) + SEMANTICA (knowledge memory: external documents/facts, §III.B) + PROCEDIMENTAL (task memory: task planning/tool-selection/observation decision history, §III.B, Fig.2). representacion=VECTOR: text segments embedded via CoIBERT and stored in a shared vector database (Eq.1, §III.C), indexed with FAISS; an auxiliary Elasticsearch/BM25 sparse-keyword index is used only at retrieval time (not the storage representation). operaciones=WRITE (segment+vectorize+store, Eq.1) + ADMISION (evaluation strategy filtering valid/positive vs invalid/negative experiences and relevant/irrelevant/conflicting knowledge before retention, §III.B) + OLVIDO (Ebbinghaus decay forgets stale segments, §III.D) + ACTUALIZACION (retrieval-triggered reset/reinforcement of forgetting-rate parameter λ, §III.D). trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM (prompt-driven evaluation strategy judging positive/negative and relevant/irrelevant/conflicting experiences at admission, §III.B) + EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (deterministic exponential-decay formula governs forgetting/update, §III.D). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS (FAISS cosine similarity, Eq.2) + GREP-ARCHIVOS (Elasticsearch/BM25 inverted-index keyword matching) + RANKING (combined recall score Scall=α·ε+(1-α)·s with temporal weighting θ, Eq.4). mide_lectura=SI: Table2 shows VIMBank vs NoAgent/ReAct/InterAct decision-success-rate deltas directly attributable to long-term-memory use (e.g. Qwen2-7b ALFWorld 48.8->72.3). alcance=SESION: memory persists and is reused 'as the dialog progresses' across multiple task rounds/similar tasks (§III intro), beyond a single task episode. fidelidad_procedencia=SI: explicit three-way classification of retrieved knowledge as relevant/irrelevant/conflicting, with the system expected to 'distinguish' contradictory historical facts about the same entity (§III.B) -- matches FIDELIDAD/costuras (rule7). F=CONSOLIDACION;COSTO (F_screening) confirmed + RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO added (rule3, mide_lectura=SI) + FIDELIDAD added (conflicting-knowledge handling, §III.B) -- both additions beyond F_screening are noted here per protocol. handoff=CONTENIDO: dialog/task memory content carried forward across rounds (§III intro, Fig.3). plan_estado=SI: task memory explicitly records the LLM's task planning/tool-selection/observation decision process (§III.B). Key numbers: Table2 success rate +10-20pts vs baseline agents; Table3 token/reasoning cost reduced by ~23-25% (§IV.D).

benchmarks: custom quantum-chemistry benchmark (6 exercises x2 difficulty, adapted from El Agente Q)
fallos_mitigaciones: A bare LLM agent without Gráfico's typed KG state made scientific errors (wrong ClF3 geometry, missed imaginary-frequency checks, mixed up solvation vs deprotonation energy, §2.2.2); within Gráfico, an imaginary-frequency failure during optimization is repaired by returning control to the main agent, which reuses the persisted intermediate ConceptualAtoms geometry (KG-retrieved) in a targeted repair loop instead of recomputing from scratch (§2.3.1).
cita: Bai et al. (2026). El Agente Gráfico: Structured Execution Graphs for Scientific Agents.
notes: mem_tipos=TRABAJO: typed Python-object execution state (ConceptualAtoms, node inputs/outputs, large numerical arrays) held in-memory or persisted to an external KG within a single agent run (§Memory Management, Fig.2c 'Workflow State (typed)' + 'Working Memory (textual)'); this is per-task execution-state memory, not long-term user/episodic memory. representacion=GRAFO: OGM serializes Python instances into KG entries with unique IRIs (§System design, Memory Management). operaciones=WRITE: OGM persists objects to the graph DB as nodes execute (Fig.2d 'Update knowledge graph (if configured)'); no explicit forget/consolidate/admit logic described. trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: writes fire deterministically at node completion within the typed execution graph, not by LLM discretion. retrieval=GRAFO: 'relation-aware queries over persisted state' + dedicated 'Knowledge graph query' tool (Fig.1). mide_lectura=NO: no isolated measurement of retrieval/read precision; evaluation is whole-system task accuracy/cost (Table1), not with/without-KG-read comparison. alcance=TAREA: state persistence scoped to propagating results 'across computation stages' within one execution graph/task, not shown to persist across sessions/projects. fidelidad_procedencia=SI: abstract explicitly states the typed-identifier design 'ensures consistency...supports provenance tracking' (unique IRIs per persisted object). benchmarks/metricas: Table1, 6 exercises x2 difficulty x10 repeats = 120 runs/LLM; numerical+judge eval (%), trace tokens, USD token cost, task duration (s) -- e.g. cost drops from $4.67 (multi-agent El Agente Q) to $0.17 with gpt-5 (~96% reduction), duration 1827s->200-300s. evidencia_tipo=ABLATION ('bare' agent without Gráfico's typed-graph/KG memory vs full Gráfico on 2 tasks, §2.2.1 'A lightweight bare LLM agent') + BENCHMARK-E2E (Table1 across 8 LLM drivers) + MEDICION-COSTO (token/cost/duration table). F=FIDELIDAD (F_screening) confirmed + COSTO added (extensive cost/latency measurement, Table1) -- addition noted per protocol. handoff=PUNTEROS: 'ConceptualAtoms identifiers served as lightweight handles for dispatching downstream...workflows' (§2.3.1) -- IRIs/handles travel between execution stages/tool calls rather than raw content; intra-task (single-agent, cross-node) handoff, not explicitly cross-session/agent. plan_estado=SI: Fig.2c 'Working Memory (textual)' explicitly stores 'Node execution summaries' alongside typed workflow state, i.e. progress/plan tracking across the execution graph.

benchmarks: OpenHarmony (10 modules), 8 open-source C projects (custom evaluation set)
fallos_mitigaciones: Initial per-function translation reaches only 39.29% Test Pass Rate despite 95.82% incremental compilation; compiler-driven per-function repair raises Test Pass Rate to 94.92% but increases Unsafe Ratio 15.95%->22.52% via brittle local fixes (e.g. alignment-based offset-guessing instead of the correct container-of layout in manager, Fig.5); mitigated by project-level agentic refinement (compilation+semantic+unsafe feedback) which restores project-consistent state handling and lowers Unsafe Ratio to 16.35% without regressing Test Pass Rate (§RQ3).
cita: Wang et al. (2026). His2Trans: A Knowledge-Guided Agentic Framework for Project-Level C-to-Rust Migration.
notes: mem_tipos=PROCEDIMENTAL: 'fragment-level knowledge records how a recurring local implementation pattern is expressed in Rust' (error-code propagation, list traversal, timeout handling, §II.A) -- how-to idioms. + SEMANTICA: 'interface-level knowledge records what Rust-side interface should be reused for a C-side operation' (§II.A) -- factual API/interface mapping. representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS: mined C/Rust pairs are 'summarized into compact guidance' stored as an offline Mapping Rule Knowledge Base (API-Level Rules, Fragment-Level Rules, Fig.2) -- text/record based, no vector/graph store described. operaciones=WRITE (offline mining builds the KB, §II.A) + CONSOLIDACION (raw C/Rust pairs 'summarized into compact guidance for retrieval', §II.A); no runtime admission/forgetting/update of the KB during agent operation. trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: KB construction is a deterministic offline mining pipeline over historical repos, not LLM-discretionary per-turn writes. retrieval=GREP-ARCHIVOS (lexical retriever collects candidate pairs, §II.A) + RANKING (explicit 'neural reranking model' orders pairs by migration relevance, both at file- and function-level, §II.A, Fig.2). mide_lectura=NO: RQ3's quantitative ablation isolates compiler-repair and project-level-refinement stages (historical-knowledge retrieval is present in ALL RQ3 settings, never turned off); RQ4's historical-knowledge analysis is explicitly qualitative case studies ('RQ4 qualitatively examines...', §IV.D), not a with/without-retrieval quantitative measurement. alcance=PROYECTO: knowledge is reused to 'remain consistent with the evolving C/Rust codebase' at the whole-project scale (title: 'Project-Level C-to-Rust Migration'; §I). multiagente=NO: single agentic pipeline (mining->translation->refinement), no shared memory across independent collaborating agents. fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no explicit staleness/verification check on the historical KB entries themselves (leakage exclusion is a dataset-hygiene control, not a memory-fidelity mechanism). benchmarks/metricas: Table IV (OpenHarmony, 10 modules) + open-source set (8 projects); Incremental Compilation Pass Rate + Test Pass Rate (EXITO), Unsafe Ratio (OTRA, a code-safety quality metric). evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (RQ3: initial-translation-only 95.82%/39.29% -> +compiler-repair 100%/94.92%(unsafe 22.52%) -> +project-refinement 100%/94.92%(unsafe 16.35%)) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Table IV vs C2Rust/C2SaferRust/EvoC2Rust/Tymcrat/Claude-Code-only) + CUALITATIVA (RQ4 case studies, Figs.3-6). F=WRITE;FIDELIDAD confirmed unchanged vs F_screening (FIDELIDAD = preserving project interfaces/observable behavior/protocols consistent with prior migration choices, §I). handoff=CONTENIDO: mined interface/fragment knowledge from earlier migrations is reused as guidance content for later translations within the same evolving project (§II.A). plan_estado=NO: no plan/progress-as-memory-content is described (static KB + fixed scaffold, not a task-plan tracker). Key numbers: OpenHarmony avg 100.00% inc.comp / 94.92% test-pass / 16.35% unsafe (Table IV); open-source set 100%/100%, unsafe 8.59% vs 42.88% C2Rust (Abstract).

benchmarks: custom synthetic workloads (4 families x6 token budgets) + 12 real coding-agent session traces + adversarial stress tests (no named public benchmark)
fallos_mitigaciones: Field reports document three recurring failure classes at agent-harness lifecycle edges (§2): residency failures (compaction silently drops directives/constraints/tool outputs), durability failures (flushes bypassed on reset, destructive overwrites), and observability failures (empty recall with no reason code). Mitigated by ClawVM's typed pages with minimum-fidelity invariants + multi-resolution degradation (full->compressed->structured->pointer), an observable fault taxonomy (refetch, duplicate-tool, pinned-invariant-miss, post-compaction-bootstrap, silent-recall, flush-miss), and a validated non-destructive writeback protocol (staging->deterministic validation->scoped commit). Against the practitioner-configured Comp-Hybrid baseline, mean explicit faults drop 1.5->0.0 and thrash -11.4% (Table4); against plain Retrieval, faults drop 67.8->0.0 and thrash -77.4%.
cita: Rafique & Bindschaedler (2026). ClawVM: Harness-Managed Virtual Memory for Stateful Tool-Using LLM Agents.
notes: mem_tipos=TRABAJO: the paper's explicit framing -- 'Stateful tool-using LLM agents treat the context window as working memory' (Abstract) -- ClawVM manages exactly this working-memory/context-window state as typed pages (Bootstrap/Policy, Constraint, Plan, Preference, Evidence, Conversation Segment, Table1), not a separate long-term user-profile store. representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS: pages are typed records (JSON snapshots) with four resolution levels -- full verbatim excerpt, compressed (LLMLingua-2 token-reduced text), structured typed fields, or a resolvable pointer (§3, §4) -- no vector/graph index. operaciones=WRITE (structured staging of updates) + ADMISION (Phase1 hard-pinned pages + Phase2 greedy budget-constrained upgrades decide residency, Listing1) + CONSOLIDACION (token-reduced 'compressed' and 'structured' representations generated per page) + OLVIDO (eviction/degradation down the F->C->St->Pt chain under budget pressure, Table1) + ACTUALIZACION (validated writeback uses 'append/merge/set-with-version' semantics, never destructive overwrite, §3 Validated writeback protocol). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (writeback fires at lifecycle boundaries: compaction/reset, §3) + PRESUPUESTO (token-budget-constrained knapsack selection, Listing1) + CHECKPOINT (staged/scoped commit at 'logged commit points', §3); explicitly NOT DISCRECIONAL-LLM by design ('Capture and recall are policy, not discretion...instead of relying on the model to flush or search', §2). retrieval=RANKING: Phase2 selects among pre-computed representations by 'marginal utility per token' (pin status, membership, recency, scope, recompute cost, Listing1) -- a deterministic utility-scoring/knapsack selection, not content-similarity search; ClawVM is explicitly 'retrieval-agnostic' w.r.t. underlying semantic-search backends (BM25/vector search are background OpenClaw building blocks, not part of ClawVM itself). mide_lectura=SI: RQ1-RQ3 quantitatively measure whether the correct state is resident/available (fault elimination, Table4-6) and downstream task success (100% vs 76.7% at the tightest budget) -- direct measurement of memory-read utility. alcance=SESION;PROYECTO: page metadata explicitly includes 'Scope (session-private vs. project-shared)' as a first-class field (§3 Pages, Table1 'P/S' column). multiagente=NO: 'multi-session interference' workload tests 2 concurrent sessions of the same harness, not shared memory across independently reasoning agents. fidelidad_procedencia=SI: pages carry explicit 'provenance (originating tool call or transcript span)...required for observability and safe writeback' (§3), and writeback validation checks 'schema correctness, provenance, scope, non-destructive semantics' (§3). evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (Table5 additive + Table6 subtractive feature ablation at budget180, e.g. removing pointer-resolution causes 126/180 faults) + BENCHMARK-E2E (RQ1 Table4 vs Retrieval/Retr.+Cache/Comp-Hybrid/Oracle across 24 configs; RQ3 30 task-level replays) + MEDICION-COSTO (median <50us policy-engine overhead per turn, Abstract). F=WRITE;FIDELIDAD (F_screening) confirmed + RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO added (rule3, mide_lectura=SI) + COSTO added (explicit per-turn overhead measurement) -- both additions noted per protocol. handoff=CONTENIDO (structured/full page content persists and reloads across compaction/reset) + PUNTEROS (pages can shrink to 'a resolvable handle plus minimal metadata', Evidence pages degrade to pointers that 'must remain resolvable', Table1). plan_estado=SI: Table1 explicitly defines a 'Plan' page type with min. fidelity 'Goal + step', i.e. the current plan/progress is itself typed memory content.
